MLforSEO Academy · The AI-powered Entity Audit

Entity Audit Scorecard

The 5C rubric as a tool: Clarity, Coverage, Consistency, Connection and Corroboration, scored 0–3 each at page and site level, with a prioritised fix list underneath.

What you need
Nothing — it runs entirely in your browser and makes no API calls
Cost
Free
Feed it
The CSVs the other tools export, or click the built-in example
You get back
A saved scorecard (JSON) and a CSV export

How to use it

  1. Click “Load the MLforSEO baseline” to see a worked example on a real site.
  2. Read the verdict first, then the five-dimension gauge.
  3. Open a dimension card to see the numbers driving that score.
  4. Work the “What to fix, in order” list — it is ranked by impact against effort.
  5. Save the scorecard. It becomes the before state you compare against in 90 days.

Worth knowing. Saving is the step people skip, and it is the one that turns a report into a measurement.
